form.label: SSH Operations Monitoring Dashboard
form.description: Operational visibility for SSH authentication activity and hygiene.

search.query: `ssh_events` | rex field=_raw "(?<outcome>Accepted|Failed) password" | stats count(eval(outcome="Accepted")) as successes, count(eval(outcome="Failed")) as failures | eval success_rate = round(successes / (successes + failures) * 100, 2) | table success_rate
`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted \S+ for (?<user>\S+)" | stats dc(user) as unique_users
`ssh_events` | rex field=_raw "(?<outcome>Accepted|Failed) password" | timechart span=1h count by outcome

panel.title: Login Heatmap (Hour vs Day of Week)

search.query: `ssh_accepted_logins` | eval hour = strftime(_time, "%H") | eval dow = strftime(_time, "%A") | stats count by hour, dow | sort hour, dow
`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted \S+ for (?<user>\S+)" | stats count by user | sort - count | head 15
`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted (?<auth_method>password|publickey|keyboard-interactive|gssapi-with-mic)" | where isnotnull(auth_method) | stats count by auth_method

`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted \S+ for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | eval login_hour = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")) | eval login_dow = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%u")) | where login_hour < 7 OR login_hour > 19 OR login_dow >= 6 | iplocation src | sort - _time | table _time, user, src, City, Country, login_hour

`ssh_accepted_logins` | rex field=_raw "Accepted \S+ for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | lookup ssh_policy_violations.csv user OUTPUT policy_violation, severity AS policy_severity, description | where isnotnull(policy_violation) | stats count values(policy_violation) as policies by user, policy_severity, description | sort - count
